effort.q: Will it be a hassle at the counter?
effort.a: No. It's two steps at the sale: you generate the QR and the customer scans it. There's nothing to type about them.

app.q: Does the customer need to download an app?
app.a: No app store needed. The wallet opens in the phone's browser and can be installed on the home screen.

system.q: Do I need to change my register or system?
system.a: No. The Counter runs in the browser of the computer, tablet or phone you already have at the counter.

results.q: What if it doesn't work for my shop?
results.a: No lock-in and no penalty: if it doesn't make sense, just tell the Lagoa+ team.

checkIn.q: How does the customer earn the stamp?
checkIn.a: At the sale, you generate the visit QR in the Counter. The customer points the camera at it (or types the short code) and the stamp lands in their wallet. The shop poster is for joining the club.

fraud.q: What if someone tries to collect too many stamps?
fraud.a: Each visit QR works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. On top of that, each customer earns at most one visit per shop in the interval you define. The redemption code is also single-use and expires in about {redeemMinutes} minutes.

reward.q: How does the customer redeem the reward?
reward.a: They generate a {redeemLength}-character code of letters and numbers, valid for about {redeemMinutes} minutes. You check it in the Counter and hand over the reward. A reward that isn't redeemed is kept for {holdDays} days, and after redemption the next card starts ahead if the welcome rule is on.

price.a: Founder costs R$ 79.90 a month and Founder Pro R$ 99.90, both with locked pricing and no lock-in. The shop joins after the network approves it. Founder pricing applies only to the first {founderSpots} shops.

plans.q: What's the difference between Founder and Pro?
plans.a: Founder has stamps, redemption and a birthday bonus, for up to 300 customers. Pro adds welcome, referral and surprise day, the list of customers who disappeared and your shop's spotlight in Discover, for up to 1,000 customers (the first {founderSpots} Pro shops have no limit).

privacy.q: What happens to my customers' data?
privacy.a: A phone number is personal data: it appears masked in lists and is never exposed.

change.q: Can I change the goal later?
change.a: Yes, whenever you want. The change creates a new version of the program: cards in progress finish on the version they started with, and new cards use the new rule.

next.q: What happens after I message on WhatsApp?
next.a: The Lagoa+ team replies within 24 hours, talks about your shop and, once the shop is approved, builds the club with you.
